title: A compatible tensor comparison map descends to one finite stage
statement: Let $I$ be a directed preorder and $F:I\to\mathrm{CommRing}$ a diagram with colimit $A$ [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Fix $i_0\in I$, commutative $F(i_0)$-algebras $B_0,C_0$, and an algebra map $\varphi_0:B_0\to C_0$. Let $P$ be a finitely presented $\mathbf Z$-algebra and $Q$ a finitely presented $P$-algebra [def-weil-pbc-finitely-presented-algebra]. Put $B=A\otimes_{F(i_0)}B_0$ and $C=A\otimes_{F(i_0)}C_0$. Give $B$ a $P$-algebra structure and a ring map $g:B\otimes_P Q\to C$ with $g\circ\iota_B=\mathrm{id}_A\otimes\varphi_0$. For $i\ge i_0$ put $B_i=F(i)\otimes_{F(i_0)}B_0$ and $C_i=F(i)\otimes_{F(i_0)}C_0$, with canonical maps $\mu_B:B_i\to B$, $\mu_C:C_i\to C$. There exist $i\ge i_0$, a $P$-algebra structure on $B_i$ making $\mu_B$ $P$-linear, and a ring map $\psi:B_i\otimes_P Q\to C_i$ such that $\psi\circ\iota_{B_i}=\mathrm{id}_{F(i)}\otimes\varphi_0$ and $\mu_C\circ\psi=g\circ(\mu_B\otimes\mathrm{id}_Q)$. No finiteness assumption on $\varphi_0$ is made.

source.place: Tag 02JO (lemma-flat-finite-presentation-limit-flat), proof of (3), construction of the maps Ψ; Tag 00QO (lemma-characterize-finite-presentation), factorization, and Tag 00DD, tensor products commute with colimits. Read online at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/02JO and https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/00DD on 2026-10-13.

proof.text: Apply the proved coefficient-structure descent theorem to obtain a stage j and its P-linear canonical map to B.

Restrict g to Q through the right tensor inclusion. The left compatibility he and the tensor balancing identity show that this map respects P. Apply the proved relative right-factor descent theorem, obtaining i, aPi, μB and q : Q → Cᵢ with scalar and factorization identities.

Equip Cᵢ with the P-structure induced by φᵢ and aPi, and view φᵢ and q as P-algebra maps. Define ψ by Algebra.TensorProduct.productMap. Its left restriction is φᵢ. For the limit equality apply ringHom_ext: on Bᵢ use he, the canonical identity for μB, and tensor induction proving the base-change square; on Q use the factorization identity for q and preservation of one.

theorem exists_comparison_map_finite_stage
    {I : Type v} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)]
    (F : I ⥤ CommRingCat.{v}) [HasColimit F]
    (i₀ : I) (B₀ : Type w) (C₀ : Type x) [CommRing B₀] [CommRing C₀]
    [Algebra (F.obj i₀) B₀] [Algebra (F.obj i₀) C₀]
    (φ₀ : B₀ →ₐ[F.obj i₀] C₀)
    (P Q : Type y) [CommRing P] [CommRing Q] [Algebra P Q]
    [Algebra.FinitePresentation ℤ P] [Algebra.FinitePresentation P Q]
    (aP : letI := (colimit.ι F i₀).hom.toAlgebra
      Algebra P (↥(colimit F) ⊗[F.obj i₀] B₀))
    (g : letI := (colimit.ι F i₀).hom.toAlgebra
      letI := aP
      (↥(colimit F) ⊗[F.obj i₀] B₀) ⊗[P] Q →+* (↥(colimit F) ⊗[F.obj i₀] C₀))
    (he : letI := (colimit.ι F i₀).hom.toAlgebra
      letI := aP
      g.comp
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeftRingHom (R := P)
          (A := ↥(colimit F) ⊗[F.obj i₀] B₀) (B := Q)) =
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (Algebra.ofId ↥(colimit F) ↥(colimit F)) φ₀).toRingHom) :
    ∃ (i : I) (hi : i₀ ≤ i),
    letI := (colimit.ι F i₀).hom.toAlgebra
    letI := (F.map (homOfLE hi)).hom.toAlgebra
    let αi : F.obj i →ₐ[F.obj i₀] ↥(colimit F) :=
      { (colimit.ι F i).hom with
        commutes' := fun s ↦
          congrArg (fun f : F.obj i₀ ⟶ colimit F ↦ f s) (colimit.w F (homOfLE hi)) }
      ∃ (aPi : Algebra P (↥(F.obj i) ⊗[F.obj i₀] B₀)),
        letI := aPi
        letI := aP
        ∃ (μB : (↥(F.obj i) ⊗[F.obj i₀] B₀) →ₐ[P]
            (↥(colimit F) ⊗[F.obj i₀] B₀)),
          μB.toRingHom =
            (Algebra.TensorProduct.map αi (AlgHom.id (F.obj i₀) B₀)).toRingHom ∧
          ∃ (ψ : ((↥(F.obj i) ⊗[F.obj i₀] B₀) ⊗[P] Q) →+*
              (↥(F.obj i) ⊗[F.obj i₀] C₀)),
            ψ.comp (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeftRingHom (R := P)
                (A := ↥(F.obj i) ⊗[F.obj i₀] B₀) (B := Q)) =
              (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (Algebra.ofId (F.obj i) (F.obj i)) φ₀).toRingHom ∧
            (Algebra.TensorProduct.map αi (AlgHom.id (F.obj i₀) C₀)).toRingHom.comp ψ =
              g.comp (Algebra.TensorProduct.map μB (AlgHom.id P Q)).toRingHom
